exposure: COVID-19 variant type (Omicron variant vs. pre-Omicron variants like pre-Delta and Delta)
outcome: Utility of risk score in assessing current status and prognosis of COVID-19 in pregnancy
Worsening of disease after initial visit
Frequency of specific risk score items (e.g., fever, mild pneumonia, blood tests, vaccination status)
Blood test parameters (platelet count, C-reactive protein, D-dimer levels)
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19, comprising 77 cases affected before the Omicron variant epoch (pre-Delta and Delta) and 50 cases affected during the Omicron variant epoch.
finding: The risk score system was effective in detecting deteriorating cases, and Omicron variant infections in pregnancy appeared less severe with no post-illness deterioration compared to previous variants, despite no significant difference in specific blood test parameters between groups.
gest_age: Measured, with no significant differences found between the groups.
